style.toneOfVoiceUnformatted:
A glass memorial bauble with a layered design. The bauble features a golden robin crafted from mirror acrylic, positioned on a holly branch. This design is overlaid onto a frosted acrylic disc.

The frosted disc allows for personalization, accommodating the name of a loved one in a handwritten-style font above the robin. An additional area provides space for a short message, such as “Loved Forever,” followed by a single line of text for dates.

The glass bauble measures approximately 10 x 10 cm.

Important information regarding personalized items:
* Delivery is estimated within 7 days for most personalized items, with confirmation provided at the point of order.
* Personalized items cannot be cancelled once an order is placed.
* Accents, special symbols, or emojis should not be included as they may not be supported by processing.
* These items are made to order and can only be returned if faulty, if they do not match their description, or if they do not meet instructions.

itemDescription.composition: 35% Acrylic, 35% Glass, 10% Other fibres, 10% Plywood, 10% Polyester.
